name: PSP-DEADSTATION-PORTABLE
description: A performance-focused PSP emulator supporting local multiplayer and downloadable recomp modules.
author: tyrannotorus

changelog.1.1.0:
- Faster graphics: quicker vertex decoding and GE command processing.
- Much faster game starts: compiled shaders kept per game.
- Consistent emulation: the same game timing on every run.
- A one-time notice about first-run shader stutter.
changelog.1.0.0: - Many PSP games run close to full-speed.
